info.name: Invite Registration
info.description:
Invite Registration lets administrators create personal, cryptographically random invitation links. New Nextcloud user accounts can only be created by opening a valid invitation link — there is no public self-service registration button.
This app works together with the Circles (Teams) app and requires it: every invitation link is tied to a team, and the new user is added to that team on registration.
Features: - Admin-generated invitation links with configurable expiry and usage limits - One-time or multi-use links - Revoke links at any time - Email verification: accounts are activated only after the user confirms their email - Per-link team assignment: the new user joins the chosen team (Circle) - Creates normal Nextcloud accounts (not guests) via the native user manager - Passwords are never stored by the app; they are passed straight to Nextcloud - No token enumeration: invalid, expired, revoked and exhausted links show a generic error
Requires the Circles app: https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/circles
